document.title: chore(js): upgrade pnpm and dependencies
document.summary: The JS workspace moves from pnpm 10.28.2 to pnpm 12.15.0, and five catalog pins move to their latest version inside the current semver range.
document.why: Machines with pnpm 12 fail `pnpm --dir js build` with `ERR_PNPM_BAD_PM_VERSION` because `packageManager` pins pnpm 10.28.2 [per the request](source:t1).

sources.label: Claude Code session · Oct 26
sources.gist: Máté asks to move packageManager to the latest pnpm, adapt config to pnpm 11/12 defaults, keep Docker/CI pins in sync, bump deps within their major, and list skipped majors in the PR.

groups.title: pnpm 12 and its new defaults
groups.why: pnpm 12 is the version on the dev machines [per the request](source:t1), and pnpm 11 turned `strictDepBuilds` on by default.
groups.summary: `packageManager` and the Dockerfile's `corepack prepare` both pin pnpm 12.15.0, and `allowBuilds: { esbuild: false }` in `pnpm-workspace.yaml` keeps the install from failing on esbuild's postinstall.
lookFor: Subtle: `esbuild: false` keeps pnpm 10's behaviour, where esbuild's postinstall was already skipped; without the entry pnpm 12 stops `pnpm install` with `ERR_PNPM_IGNORED_BUILDS`.

Subtle: the Dockerfile still uses `corepack prepare`, which only works because nodesource's Node 22 now ships corepack 0.36; corepack before 0.35 looks for `bin/pnpm.cjs` and crashes, which the new `AGENTS.md` setup line documents.

groups.title: Catalog bumps within the current major
groups.why: The request asks for the latest non-breaking version of each workspace dependency [per the request](source:t1).
groups.summary: The catalog in `pnpm-workspace.yaml` bumps `@types/node`, `@types/react`, `oxlint`, `rolldown` and `tsx`, and the scaffold template's `@types/react` pin follows the catalog.
lookFor: `rolldown` goes from `1.0.0-rc.18` to `1.2.15`; it is a runtime dependency of `@vitadeck/sdk`, so authors' `vitadeck build` bundles with it too.
`oxlint` stops at `1.72.0` because 1.73+ needs `oxlint-tsgolint` 0.24+ or 7.x, outside the pinned `0.23.0` range.

commits.subject: chore(js): upgrade pnpm to 12.15.0 and dependencies within major
commits.author: Máté Molnár
commits.body:
- packageManager pnpm@12.15.0; lockfile regenerated (pnpm 11+ layout)
- allowBuilds: esbuild false keeps pnpm 10's skipped build under strictDepBuilds
- Dockerfile corepack pin follows packageManager
- catalog: @types/node 25.9.9, @types/react 18.3.31, oxlint 1.72.0, rolldown 1.2.15, tsx 4.23.15
- AGENTS.md: corepack < 0.35 cannot launch pnpm 11+

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
